title: Dashboard CAPEX/OPEX Prioritization & Scorecard — notes
content:
Purpose
-----
Working notes for scoring dashboard and instrumentation work against CAPEX/OPEX tradeoffs. Goal: provide a replicable rubric so PMs, SREs, and product engineers can decide which panels and metrics to build/keep, and quantify expected cost savings vs. operational risk. This is a planning doc (informal) not final governance policy.

Top-level problem statement
-------------------------
- Observability surface has grown: dozens of panels, multiple tracing samplers, synthetic probes per region.
- Dashboard sprawl increases query cost (Grafana/Presto) and dashboard maintenance headcount.
- Investments (native widget dev, backend rollups, trace enrichment) require both one-time engineering effort (CAPEX) and recurring cost (OPEX) for ingestion, retention, and query egress.
- Need a small, objective scorecard for prioritizing work and deprecating panels.

Proposed scorecard — fields and rationale
---------------------------------------
For each candidate dashboard/panel/metric, score 0-5 on the following axes and compute a weighted sum. Weights are configurable at the org/quarter level.
- Operational Impact (weight default 0.35) — how much this metric/panel reduces mean-time-to-detect or mean-time-to-resolve a P1/P2 outage. (0: no impact, 5: critical)
- Cost delta (weight default 0.25) — combined expected change in monthly OPEX (ingest & query) and CAPEX (one-off engineering). Use negative sign for cost increases. Translate to score bucket: cost savings -> higher score.
- User-facing risk (weight default 0.15) — probability that removing/degrossing the panel increases user-visible errors or SLA risk.
- Instrumentation effort (weight default 0.10) — engineering hours to implement or maintain. Lower effort -> higher score.
- Data fidelity/usefulness (weight default 0.15) — semantic clarity, reproducibility, and ties to SLOs.

Scoring examples (toy)
---------------------
- KV-cache warmth microprobe panel: OpImpact 4, CostDelta 3 (saves CPU on dedupe queries), Risk 2, Effort 2, Fidelity 4 -> weighted score ~3.6 -> high priority for optimizing to reduce query cost.
- Long-tail token latency histogram with heavy cardinality label: OpImpact 3, CostDelta -2 (increases query cost), Risk 2, Effort 4, Fidelity 2 -> weighted ~1.7 -> candidate for downsampling or moving to synthetic probe.

Suggested policy actions for score bands
---------------------------------------
- >= 3.5: Green — build and maintain, consider converting to high-availability backend (pre-aggregates).
- 2.0–3.5: Yellow — keep but apply cost controls (lower retention, reduce default time window, gated by feature flag).
- < 2.0: Red — mark for deprecation, replace with lightweight synthetic probe or ad-hoc debug-only dashboard.

Tracing & sampling recommendations (integration with scorecard)
-------------------------------------------------------------
- For high-cost/low-value traces flagged by scorecard, propose adaptive sampling: 1% baseline + conditional 100% sampling for anomalies (latency > p99 threshold OR error code X).
- Annotate traces with panel provenance: add a label `panel_owner` and `panel_score` in trace metadata so investigation pipelines can group traces by dashboard ROI.
- Run a 2-week experiment: reduce sampling by 50% for candidate trace classes and measure change in investigator time and trace utility (survey small ops cohort).

Dashboard design notes (cost-aware UX)
-------------------------------------
- Default time window: change from 30d -> 7d for heavy panels; provide quick selector for longer lookback behind a confirmation dialog that notes approximate extra query cost.
- Panel collapse by tenant: default hide tenant-level breakdowns unless the dashboard is in 'Investigate' mode. Tenant splits add high cardinality.
- One-click synthetic probe migration: for panels scoring <2.0, provide a UI path to convert to a synthetic probe template (maintains alerting surface without per-row cardinality ingestion).

Metric definition checklist (what to include in each metric doc)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- short_name (single token), display_name, owner (email), SLA mapping (SLO id), aggregation method (count/sum/quantile), tags (tenant, model, route), cardinality notes, default retention / pre-agg policy, expected monthly cost delta, linked_dashboards, rollout checklist (feature flag, alert lifecycle).
- Enforcement: new metric onboarding must fill this checklist in Confluence (link in linked_artifacts).

Investigations & measurement plan (how we validate scorecard efficacy)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
- Phase 0 (2 weeks): baseline snapshot of dashboard query costs, alert noise rate, and average debugging time for a rotating ops cohort (3 people).
- Phase 1 (4 weeks): apply scorecard to 40 candidate panels -> categorize and apply recommended action (optimize, gate, deprecate).
- Phase 2 (8 weeks): measure delta in monthly query cost, SLO noise, and MTTR for incidents impacted by changed panels.
- Success criteria: >20% reduction in query cost for the observability workspace w/o >5% increase in P1 MTTR.

Open questions / TODOs
---------------------
- Decide quarterly weights for the scorecard (ops-focused Q vs product-focused Q). Proposed default above but needs leadership buy-in.
- Concrete cost model: need a small script to estimate monthly OPEX per metric/panel (approx token/row counts * retention * query rate). Ticket: JIRA-OBS-487.
- UX: do we want a built-in cost confirmation modal in Grafana or a separate console flow? Check with Console team (Lina).
- Add owner lifecycle: how long before a stale owner gets replaced automatically? (proposal: 3 quarters w/o changes -> auto-assign to 'obs-curation' rotation).

Quick action items (next 2 sprints)
----------------------------------
1) Create a Confluence template for the metric definition checklist (Priya) — due 2026-01-17.
2) Small cost-estimate script (Marcus) — prototype by 2026-01-24.
3) Run pilot scorecard on top 60 panels by query cost (Ethan + ops) — start 2026-01-20.
4) UX mock for `convert-to-synthetic-probe` flow (Lina) — wireframes by 2026-01-31.

Notes to self / shorthand
------------------------
- Avoid full deprecation waves right before big rollouts.
- Keep a fallback bucket: "debug-only" with retention 7d, 1x sampling, no tenant splits.
- When optimizing: prefer server-side rollups (aggregations at ingest) over client-side query tricks unless latency-sensitive.

Relevant links and references
----------------------------
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-OBS-DASHBOARD-PRIORITY-1 (doc with initial scoring matrix)
- JIRA: JIRA-OBS-487 (cost-estimate script)
- PR prototype: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/obs-scorecard/pull/4

End of notes — this is intentionally concise. Keep iterating and bring to ops/product sync next Tuesday.
